product.description: The Dyson V15 Detect is a powerful and intelligent cordless vacuum designed for whole-home deep cleaning. It features laser illumination to reveal invisible dust on hard floors and a piezo sensor that optimizes power and run time based on the debris detected, with real-time reporting on an integrated LCD screen. The vacuum includes a de-tangling Digital Motorbar™ cleaner head for carpets and hard floors, and the Fluffy Optic™ cleaner head for hard surfaces. Its versatile design allows it to convert into a handheld vacuum with one click, making it ideal for cars, stairs, and upholstery. The system is completed with advanced whole-machine filtration that traps 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3 microns.

product.title: GoPro HERO13 Black in Forest Green
product.description: The GoPro HERO13 Black in Forest Green is a rugged, limited edition action camera designed for high-performance adventure capture. It features a 1/1.9" image sensor capable of recording 5.3K60, 4K120, and 2.7K240 video, as well as 27MP raw photos. The camera is equipped with HyperSmooth 6.0 digital image stabilization with AutoBoost for steady footage and is waterproof up to 33 feet without a housing. It includes a high-capacity 1900mAh Enduro battery for extended runtimes in various weather conditions and supports HB-series lens mods for specialized shooting. The device features both front and rear LCD screens and offers seamless connectivity via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi 6 through the GoPro Quik app.
